name: Cap-Haitien

queries.query: Cap-Haitien Haiti official cadastral map parcel cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery found IHSI geographic maps, CIAT land/cadastre policy material, and Cap-Haïtien-specific official project documentation. No public parcel viewer or open parcel geometry service was identified.

queries.query: Cap-Haïtien Haïti carte cadastrale officiel / Kap Ayisyen Ayiti kat cadastral tè
queries.result: French and Haitian-Creole discovery found the official CIAT and IHSI sources, and HaitiDocs administrative boundary data. HaitiDocs is administrative-boundary data (ADM1-ADM3), not parcel data; no local open parcel service was found.

requests.outcome: Official CIAT page was discovered but unavailable during direct TLS-verified fetch; search-indexed official content describes cadastre and land institutions. No retry storm or bypass attempted.
Official IHSI geographic-data page loaded. It exposes departmental and urban-percentage JPG maps, including Département du Nord; no parcel layer, schema, or parcel API was exposed.
Official DGI site map loaded. No public cadastral viewer, parcel download, or safe parcel-geometry endpoint was exposed in the inspected site map.
Public boundary dataset loaded; the advertised GeoJSON is OCHA COD-AB administrative boundaries (ADM1-ADM3), not cadastral parcels. Not retained as a parcel sample.
The page identifies this as administrative ADM2 GeoJSON, outside the parcel-safe target scope; no request was needed.

sourceFindings.finding: Official report states that DGI determines land status, acts are supplied to ONACA for Plan foncier de base georeferencing, and a DGI Cap-Haïtien annex is involved; it also says the study did not provide cadastral plans.
CIAT presents cadastral and land-security policy material; this is institutional context, not an open parcel service.

registryBasis: A Cap-Haïtien-specific official MTPTC project report identifies the DGI Cap-Haïtien annex and describes DGI/ONACA cadastral-plan responsibilities. This evidences a local cadastral custodian/procedure, but not an open public parcel viewer or downloadable geometry service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DGI/ONACA cadastral procedures and public official geographic sources relevant to Cap-Haïtien.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: IHSI departmental/urban maps and administrative boundary data only; no parcel geometry or parcel schema verified.

technicalBlocker: No public cadastral viewer, anonymous parcel endpoint, or open parcel vector service was exposed by the inspected first-party sources. The CIAT page returned HTTP 503 on direct fetch, while the Cap-Haïtien-specific official report explicitly notes cadastral plans were not provided.
remainingUncertainty: The WUP point was preserved and never used to force a parcel query. Public availability, current update currency, legal boundary status, municipal coverage, parcel identifiers, and geometry access remain unresolved. A timeout, unavailable page, or absent public endpoint is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification required
